game.title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
game.blurb: Anime arena fighting game in the Budokai Tenkaichi line, from Spike Chunsoft, released 2025-10-10 (RAWG date). RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, Fighting. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1790600)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Dragon_Ball:_Sparking!_Zero
Fandom (dragonball.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://dragonball.fandom.com/wiki/Dragon_Ball:_Sparking!_Zero
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); of its subpages only "Achievements and trophies" and "Table of Contents" exist (Walkthrough, Gameplay and Controls are not written), so nothing was used. Its categories list both 2024 and 2025, while RAWG gives 2025-10-10 as the release date; the year here follows RAWG. dragonball.fandom.com answers the API with about 340 linked articles, mostly characters and places; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "zero" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1790600. 21 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story sagas chapter, since only "Completed Goku's Saga" is visible. "A Taste of Victory" and "Winning Streak" (match wins) do not say which mode counts. Online battles need a network connection.
